[[Olympique de Marseille]] won '''Division 1 season 1947/1948''' of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] with 48 points.

==Participating teams==

===Changes from previous season===
'''Teams promoted from [[1946–47 French Division 2]]'''
* Champions: [[FC Sochaux-Montbéliard|Sochaux]]
* Runners-up: [[Olympique Alès]]

'''Teams relegated to [[1947–48 French Division 2]]'''
* 17th placed: [[RC Lens|Lens]]
* 18th placed: [[FC Girondins de Bordeaux|Bordeaux]]
* 19th placed: [[Le Havre AC|Le Havre]]
* 20th placed: [[FC Rouen|Rouen]]
